focus.jnote: The tape is two-sided again. And rates are heavy: the 10-year yield climbed ~6.5 bps to near 5.15% as WTI surged past $104, lifting inflation expectations. This is a headline-driven tape — exactly where a Sniper trades small and only on confirmed setups.

The scanner boarded it bearish, but the same thin-volume caveat applies — a double-beat gapping DOWN is a fragile bearish thesis that can snap back on any dip-buy; half size and validate direction at 9:35.
focus.why: Why YELLOW? Composite ~54 is WARM and P(≥1% gap) ~39% is above the 35% trigger — either alone locks out GREEN. Monday's bounce is a snap-back, not an all-clear; a renewed leg lower could spill from chips into the broad tape.

Treat both as half-size, confirm-at-9:35 names, not table-pounders; if volume/direction doesn't hold, stand aside.
